TedWu## Ted Wu
### Tenure
2003– Present
### Title
SVP, Global Head of Design, Vehicles and Building Sets
**Theodore Wu**is a Chinese-American Mattel employee who has been working at Mattel since 2003. Initially employed as an associate producer, he quickly worked up the ranks to eventually become a senior marketing manager; he eventually became the vice-president of design for Hot Wheels in 2015, taking over fromFelix Holst. He is currently the senior vice-president and global head of design, vehicles and building sets, a position he has held since 2024.
